verdict.rationale: Lago documents that customers can upgrade or downgrade their plan at any moment, and that it generates invoices automatically and exposes an invoice object. However, the evidence never mentions proration, credits for unused time, partial-period calculation, or how line items reconcile. Missing for 10: documented proration math, credit note handling on downgrade, partial-period line-item breakdown, penny-level reconciliation evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
